spans.s:
m. (-ङ्कः)
1 The bend or elbow of a river, the winding course of a stream.
2 Crookedness.
f. (-ङ्का)
The pummel of a saddle.
E.
वकि to curve or bend, aff. अच्.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The ocean, the sea.
E.
वङ्क a bend or creek, aff. अण्.

m. (-लः)
A thorn.
E.
वङ्क crookedness, and इलच् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं)
Crooked, curved.
E.
वञ्च to go, ण्यत् aff., and च changed to क.

m. (-ङ्क्रिः)
1 A rib.
2 The wood of a thatch.
3 A particular musical instrument.
E.
वकि to be crooked, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
The groin, the public and iliac regions.
E.
वाञ्छि to desire, ल्युट् aff., and the form irr., or वक्ष to accumulate, ल्युट् aff., and नुम् augment.

f. (-ङ्क्षुः)
A small arm or branch of the Ganges.
E.
वङ्क्ष to accumulate, aff. उ.

Lead.
2

Tin.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Bengal, or the eastern parts of the modern province.
2

Cotton.
3

The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
वगि to go, युच् aff.

m. (-नः)
The egg-plant.
E.
वगि to go, युच् aff.

n. (-जं)
Brass.
E.
वङ्ग tin, शुल्व copper, and ज produced; an alloy of tin and copper.

m. (-नः)
The Sesbana grandiflora.
E.
वङ्ग Bengal, सि to sew, aff. ल्युट्; also with कन् added, वङ्गसेनक.

m. (-रिः)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
वङ्ग lead, and अरि a foe.

f. (-ला)
A mode of music.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Eloquent, rhetorical.
n. (-यं)
1

Eloquence.
2

Rhetorical composition, rhetoric, belles lettres.
f. (-यी)
SARASVATĪ.
E.
वाक् speech, and मयट् aff.

m. (-खः)
The opening of a speech, an exordium.
E.
वाच् speech, मुख principal or beginning.
